name: How long does garage painting and trim work usually take?
description: Small garages can take a few days, while bigger projects may take up to a week. The condition of the walls, ceiling, and trim usually drives the schedule.

mainEntity.name: How long does garage painting and trim work usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the garage size and how much repair work is needed before painting starts. Smaller garages may take a few days, while larger or more damaged spaces can take up to a week or more if trim needs extra prep or repair.
